body.text: ACCEPTED with a named two-mode mechanism. (a) Agreed: the stated adversary is a prompt-injected/compromised agent reasoning loop with arbitrary tool calls and arbitrary project-dir writes at the same uid — NOT a same-uid human attacker; guardian-uid compromise is out of scope (trust kernel). security-architecture.md now has an explicit 'Adversary model' section. (b) Named mechanism: STANDARD mode = guardian under a dedicated OS uid (documented launchd/sudoers recipe; keyfile 0600 guardian-owned; UDS 0700; agent uid may connect but never read; falsifiable via sudo -u <agent> cat <keyfile> failing). DEGRADED mode (hackathon laptop, same uid) = the uid wall is absent and the property reduces to context hygiene: no agent-reachable tool returns/accepts/logs key material; exfiltration requires actively locating a path no tool surfaces. Degraded mode is labeled at guardian startup and recorded in session metadata — documented residual risk, never silent. Both modes are in the trust-boundary diagram.
